result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make people better at understanding each other across differences.

Not everyone would suddenly agree, but misunderstandings, fear, and bad faith would shrink. Conversations would become less about “winning” and more about seeing why others care the way they do. If that shifted politics, relationships, and daily life, almost everything else would start changing too.
